insertOutlines(_:db:)
WITH matches AS (
    SELECT id, object_type, drawing_id, page_id, page_no
    FROM (
        SELECT
            searchable_pages.id,
            searchable_pages.object_type,
            searchable_pages.drawing_id,
            searchable_pages.page_id,
            searchable_pages.text,
            pages.page_no,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY searchable_pages.object_type, searchable_pages.drawing_id ORDER BY pages.page_no ASC) AS rn
        FROM 
            searchable_pages_fts
            INNER JOIN searchable_pages ON (searchable_pages_fts.ROWID = searchable_pages.id) 
            INNER JOIN pages ON (searchable_pages.page_id = pages.id) 
            INNER JOIN library_nodes ON (searchable_pages.drawing_id = library_nodes.id) 
        WHERE 
            searchable_pages_fts MATCH ? AND library_nodes.is_deleted = 0
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
SELECT
    object_type, drawing_id, page_id, page_no, snippet(searchable_pages_fts, 0, '!>>', '', '', 5) snippet
FROM
    matches JOIN searchable_pages_fts ON matches.id = searchable_pages_fts.ROWID 
    AND searchable_pages_fts MATCH ?
